crm_notes:
Short notes from AE/SE/CSM:
- Customer is product analytics platform embedding LLMs for doc search, in-app assistant, and contextual recommendations.
- Hosted trial promising; their main pain: unpredictable throttling during product releases and loss of model pinning across tenants.
- Token mix: many short queries (KB lookup) and a non-trivial tail of long summarizations (customer config exports, release notes). average tokens ~185.
- Requested: can Dedicated support sustained 50 QPS with spikes to 150-250 QPS for 5-20 minutes? they want autoscale to 2x within 90s.
- SE Priya: recommend starting with 6x GPU cluster for base (estimated sustained QPS ~70 for chosen model family) with autoscale headroom to 12 GPUs for burst; caching and small batching window (15ms) recommended.
- Cost preference: committed monthly slots with predictable spend; they will accept a small premium vs variable usage. procurement prefers 6-month pilot.
- Security: must be VPC control plane and customer KMS. retention policy 12 months for audit logs.
- Quote ask: compare 3/6/12 GPU configs, show per-token economics at current token mix and with worst-case tail.
- Customer comment on call: "We need certainty — spikes during launches broke our chat once and caused delays to paying customers."
capacity_and_forecast_summary: Baseline from hosted trial: avg daily QPS ~12, typical peak 45 QPS, 99th concurrency ~28, avg tokens/call 185. Customer target: baseline sustained 50 QPS with autoscale to handle bursts 150-250 QPS (10-20m). Recommendation: start with 6-GPU Dedicated cluster (model quantized) for base load with autoscale policy to 12 GPUs for bursts; enable prefix caching for KB queries to reduce token generation by ~20% for repeat queries. Forecasting: conservative monthly commit priced for 70% utilization of base capacity, with overage bands for burst minutes; projected ARR range $120k-$600k depending on commit length and support tier.
technical_requirements:
- Sustained in-region throughput: 50 QPS.
- Burst: 150-250 QPS for 5-20 minutes, expected 1-3 bursts/week during releases.
- Autoscale target: scale 6->12 GPUs within 90-180s.
- Latency SLO: p50 <220ms for responses <512 tokens; p95 <900ms.
- Token profile: avg 185 tokens; 70% short (<300), 20% mid, 10% long (>900).
- Security: VPC control plane, customer CMK in AWS, SSO/SAML, SOC2 compliance, audit logs retention 12 months, US-only residency.
- Ops: console + API access for infra, cost dashboards for product.
- Rollout: 72h shadow run -> canary to 10% tenants -> ramp to full cutover after performance + security sign-off.
poC_milestones:
1) Exchange network details and grant shadow run access (customer to provide bastion/NAT).
2) Conduct 72-hour shadow run capturing full request traces, QPS, concurrency, token sizes, and model-specific latency.
3) Validate autoscaler behavior with synthetic 3-5x bursts; measure scale-up time and tail latencies.
4) Run top-30 prompt regression tests for quality and perf.
5) Security review: deliver SOC2 report + KMS integration test.
6) Finalize SOW and committed pricing for 6-month pilot if metrics meet agreed SLOs.
